messages.content: You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is Karini?

Karini is an all-in-one Tunisian e-learning platform built for serious students. It offers curated video courses, practice exercises with detailed corrections, secure PDF magazines, and recorded live sessions — all organized by the Tunisian curriculum from 7ème Année de Base (collège) through Baccalauréat. A transparent credit-based system lets you unlock content flexibly.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I create an account?

Click 'Create free account' on the homepage or go to the Register page. You'll need to fill in your first name, last name, email, password, phone number, gender, age, and select your class level (from 7ème Année de Base to Bac). If you are under 18, you must also provide your parent's email and phone number — a parent account will be created automatically. If you are 18 or older, your CIN (Carte d'Identité Nationale) number is required.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
I forgot my password.

No problem! Go to the login page and click 'Forgot Password'. Enter your registered email address and you'll receive instructions to reset your password. Follow the link in the email to set a new password (at least 6 characters).

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I log in?

Go to the Login page (click 'Sign in to platform' on the homepage). Enter the email and password you used during registration, then click Sign In. You'll be taken to your personalized student dashboard.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What membership plans are available?

Karini offers 4 membership tiers in credits:

1. **Standard** (0 crédit / Gratuit) — Basic monthly access included at registration: open courses, basic exercises, public magazines, and progress tracking.

2. **Silver** (100 crédits / mois) — Full access to all video courses & lessons, exercise series with detailed corrections, and PDF magazine downloads. Valid for 30 days.

3. **Gold** (250 crédits / mois) — Everything in Silver plus exclusive access to Live Archives (recorded live session replays) and unlimited magazine downloads. Valid for 30 days.

4. **Platinum** (500 crédits / an) — Annual subscription valid until June 15 (Bac exam period). Includes interactive Live Sessions with teachers, open mic, certificates, and full access to everything.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is the Standard membership?

The Standard membership is the free tier you get automatically when you register. It includes basic monthly access to open courses, basic practice exercises, public magazine downloads, and personal progress tracking. You can upgrade anytime using your credits.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is included in the Silver membership?

The Silver membership is a monthly plan (30-day validity) that includes:
• Full access to all video courses and lessons
• Exercise series with detailed corrections (corrigés)
• PDF magazine downloads and reading
• Personal progress tracking

It renews monthly via your credit balance.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is inside the Gold membership?

The Gold membership is a monthly plan that includes everything in Silver plus:
• ⭐ Exclusive full access to Live Archives (replays of past live sessions)
• Exclusive Karini content and exercises
• Unlimited downloads of all magazines

It renews every 30 days via your credit balance.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is the Platinum membership?

The Platinum membership is an annual subscription valid for the entire school year until June 15 (Bac exam period). It includes:
• 💎 Exclusive real-time Live Sessions calendar
• Interactive direct sessions with the best teachers (open mic & chat)
• Unlimited access to all video courses, exercises, and PDF magazines
• Official validation certificates
• Early access to all new content

No matter when you subscribe during the year, it covers you through June 15.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Why does Platinum end on June 15?

The Platinum pass is structured around the Tunisian school year and ends on June 15 because that's when the Baccalauréat exams are scheduled. Regardless of when you subscribe during the year, Platinum guarantees continuous access to Live sessions and all courses until June 15.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I upgrade my membership?

Go to the Membership page (click 'Gérer mon abonnement & crédits' from your dashboard, or navigate to /membership). You'll see all available plans with their credit prices. Click the subscribe button on the plan you want — the cost is deducted from your credit balance in one click. Make sure you have enough credits before upgrading.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What are credits and how do they work?

Credits are the internal currency on Karini. You use credits to:
• Subscribe to Silver, Gold, or Platinum memberships
• Unlock specific exercises and support materials

Your credit balance is displayed on your student dashboard. You can check it anytime on your profile or the membership page.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I get more credits?
Credits can be added to your account by the platform administrator. Contact the Karini support team or your school's administrator to purchase additional credits for your account.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
I don't have enough credits to subscribe. What do I do?

If your credit balance is too low to purchase a membership plan, you'll see a message like 'Crédits insuffisants'. You need to top up your credits first — contact the Karini support team or your platform administrator to add credits to your account, then return to the Membership page to complete your subscription.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How does membership renewal work?

For Silver and Gold, your membership is valid for 30 days and is renewed manually by clicking the subscribe button again and paying with credits. For Platinum, it's a one-time annual subscription that stays active without interruption until June 15 of the current school year — no renewal needed.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
When does my membership expire?

Your membership expiration date is shown on the Membership page under your current plan. Silver and Gold memberships expire 30 days after activation. Platinum expires on June 15 of the school year. You can also see the expiration date on your student dashboard.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What subjects are available on Karini?

Karini covers the full Tunisian curriculum, including:
• Mathématiques (Math)
• Physique-Chimie
• Sciences (SVT)
• Informatique
• Français
• Anglais
• Arabe
• Philosophie
• Économie & Gestion
• Histoire-Géographie

Subjects are organized by filière and class level, so you only see content relevant to your specific program.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What class levels does Karini support?

Karini supports the full Tunisian educational system:

**Collège (Enseignement de Base):** 7ème, 8ème, 9ème Année de Base

**1ère Année Secondaire:** Tronc Commun

**2ème Année Secondaire:** Informatique, Sciences, Économie & Services, Lettres

**3ème Année Secondaire:** Informatique, Mathématiques, Sciences Expérimentales, Sciences Techniques, Économie & Gestion, Lettres, Sport

**Baccalauréat (4ème Année):** Bac Informatique, Bac Mathématiques, Bac Sciences Expérimentales, Bac Sciences Techniques, Bac Économie & Gestion, Bac Lettres, Bac Sport

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I access my courses?

From your student dashboard, click 'Accéder à mes cours' or navigate to the Courses page. Courses are automatically filtered for your assigned class (filière). You'll see tabs for: Cours Vidéo, Exercices PDF, Magazines PDF, and Direct (Live Archives). Click on any tab to browse available content.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What types of content does Karini offer?

Karini provides four main content categories:

1. **Cours Vidéo** — Structured, multi-chapter video courses designed by experts, viewable in an interactive video player or grid layout.
2. **Exercices PDF** — Hands-on practice exercises and quizzes with instant feedback and detailed corrections.
3. **Magazines PDF** — Curated learning magazines and research papers, served securely with authenticated downloads.
4. **Direct (Live Archives)** — Replays of past live streams, webinars, and interactive Q&A sessions (requires Gold membership).

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I watch video courses?

Go to the Courses page and select the 'Cours Vidéo' tab. You can toggle between two viewing modes:
• **Lecteur Vidéo (Video Player)** — An interactive studio with a playlist on the left and the video player on the right.
• **Grille (Grid)** — Browse all video courses as cards in a grid layout.

Click on any course to start watching. Courses contain multiple lessons (video, text, or PDF) that you can progress through in order.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What are lessons inside a course?

Each course on Karini contains multiple lessons, which can be:
• **Video lessons** — YouTube videos or uploaded video files
• **Text lessons** — Written explanations and summaries
• **PDF lessons** — Downloadable documents

Lessons are ordered sequentially, and your progress (completed/not completed, watch time) is tracked automatically so you can pick up where you left off.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Is my progress saved?

Yes! Karini automatically tracks your learning progress. For each lesson, the system records whether you've completed it, how many seconds you've watched, and your last position in the video. This means you can leave and come back anytime without losing your place.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I access exercises?

Go to the Courses page and click on the 'Exercices PDF' tab. You'll see available exercise series for your class. These include practice problems and detailed corrections (corrigés) to help you prepare for exams.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I download magazines?

Navigate to the Courses page and click on the 'Magazines PDF' tab. You'll see the available learning magazines for your class. Click on a magazine to view it using the built-in PDF viewer or download it. Magazine access depends on your membership level — Silver, Gold, and Platinum members have full download access.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I access Live Archives (replays)?

Live Archives are available under the 'Direct' tab on the Courses page. However, this section is exclusively reserved for **Gold** members. If you're on Standard, Silver, or even Platinum, you'll see a message asking you to upgrade to Gold. Go to the Membership page to upgrade.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What are Live Sessions?

Live Sessions are real-time interactive classes conducted by Karini's best teachers. They include:
• Live course sessions and intensive exam revision
• Open mic and chat so you can ask questions directly
• Step-by-step resolution of Bac exam subjects
• Unlimited replays of recordings

Live Sessions are shown on a calendar and are **exclusively available to Platinum members**. You can join directly via a Google Meet link.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I join a Live Session?

If you're a Platinum member, go to the Live page (/live). You'll see a calendar with all scheduled sessions. Click on a day to see the sessions planned, then click the 'Rejoindre le direct' button to open the Google Meet link and join the live class. You can also filter sessions by subject.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Why can't I access Live Sessions?

Live Sessions are an exclusive feature reserved for **Platinum members only**. If you're on Standard, Silver, or Gold, you'll see a VIP gate page asking you to upgrade. Go to the Membership page and subscribe to the Platinum plan (annual subscription until June 15) to unlock Live Sessions.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is the difference between Live Sessions and Live Archives?

**Live Sessions** (Platinum only) are real-time interactive classes where you can join, ask questions via open mic, and interact with teachers as they happen.

**Live Archives** (Gold only) are recordings/replays of past live sessions that you can watch at your own pace.

They require different memberships: Live Sessions need Platinum, Live Archives need Gold.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What are quizzes on Karini?

Quizzes are interactive assessments attached to courses or specific lessons. Each quiz has:
• A title and optional time limit (duration in minutes)
• Multiple-choice questions with point values
• A maximum number of attempts allowed

After completing a quiz, you get your score, percentage, and a breakdown showing which answers were correct or incorrect. Your best score is tracked over multiple attempts.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How many times can I take a quiz?

Each quiz has a maximum number of attempts set by the teacher. You can retake the quiz up to that limit. Your best score across all attempts is tracked and recorded. Check the quiz details to see how many attempts remain.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What are assignments?

Assignments (devoirs) are tasks set by your teachers with:
• A title and description
• A due date and maximum score
• A target class and subject
• Optional instruction files to download

You can submit your answer as text or upload a file. Your teacher will then grade your submission and provide feedback and a score.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I submit an assignment?

Go to the Assignments page from your dashboard. Find the assignment you need to complete, then either type your answer in the text field or upload a file. Click submit before the due date. Your teacher will review it and you'll receive a score and feedback.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I change my class or filière?

Your class (filière) is assigned during registration and managed by the platform administrator or moderator. You cannot change it yourself. If your class needs to be updated (for example, you moved to the next year), contact the administrator or your moderator — they can update your assignment from the admin panel.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is a student group?

Students can be assigned to one of four groups by moderators:
• **DabaDaba** — Entry level
• **Standard** — Regular level
• **Excellent** — Advanced level
• **Top** — Highest level

Groups help organize students by academic performance and may determine which Live Sessions are targeted to you. Your group is visible on your dashboard.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I update my profile?

Go to the Profile page (click your avatar or navigate to /profile). From there you can update your personal information such as your name, profile picture, phone number, and other details. Some fields like your class and membership are managed by administrators.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Can I change my email or password?

To change your password, go to the Profile page and use the password update section. To reset a forgotten password, use the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page. For email changes, contact the platform administrator as this may require verification.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I contact my teacher?

You can message your teachers directly through the built-in messaging system. Go to your dashboard or the messages section to start or continue a conversation. Messages are sent in real-time via the platform's chat system, and you'll see unread message counts so you don't miss any replies.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Can my parents follow my progress?

Yes! If you're under 18, a parent account was automatically created when you registered. Your parent can log in to their own dashboard to:
• See a weekly summary of your activity (lessons completed, minutes watched, average quiz scores, live sessions attended)
• View your class, membership, and student group
• Message your teachers directly
• Track your progress over time with comparisons to previous weeks

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What can my parent see on their dashboard?

The parent dashboard shows:
• **Weekly Summary**: Lessons completed, minutes watched, average quiz score, and live sessions attended — with comparisons to the previous week
• **Child Info**: Your name, class (filière), membership tier, and student group
• **Teacher Messages**: Parents can view and send messages to your teachers
• **Progress Tracking**: Detailed view of your child's learning activity

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How does my parent get their login credentials?

When a minor student (under 18) registers, a parent account is automatically created using the parent email provided during registration. The login credentials and instructions are sent to that parent email address. The parent can then use those credentials to log in and access their dashboard.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
I'm under 18, why do I need to provide parent information?

For students under 18, Karini requires a parent or guardian's email and phone number for safety and accountability. A parent account is automatically created so your parent or tutor can:
• Monitor your learning progress
• Communicate with your teachers
• Stay informed about your academic activity

This is a mandatory requirement — the parent email must be different from the student's email.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
I'm 18 or older, why do I need a CIN?

For students aged 18 and above, Karini requires your CIN (Carte d'Identité Nationale) number for official identification and registration purposes. This is a standard requirement in the Tunisian educational system for adult students. Your CIN is stored securely.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is the Library page?

The Library page (/library) is where you can browse all available learning resources across the platform. It serves as a centralized catalog to explore courses, exercises, magazines, and other materials organized by subject and filière.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I browse courses by subject?

Go to the Courses page where you'll see courses organized by sections (Cours Vidéo, Exercices, Magazines, Direct). Each course is tagged with its subject and filière. You can also browse by subject from the Subjects page, where subjects are listed for your specific class (e.g., Math, Physique, Informatique for Bac Informatique).

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Why do I only see courses for my class?

Karini automatically adapts content to your assigned class (filière). When you registered, you selected your class level (e.g., Bac Informatique, 2ème Sciences). The platform filters courses, exercises, and subjects to show only what's relevant to your specific program. This ensures you don't get overwhelmed with content from other levels.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Is Karini free to use?

Karini has a free Standard tier that gives you basic access to open courses, exercises, and public magazines when you register. For full access to all video courses, exercise corrections, magazine downloads, live archives, and live sessions, you'll need to upgrade to Silver, Gold, or Platinum using credits.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is a filière?

A filière is an academic track or stream in the Tunisian educational system. It defines your specialization, especially from 2ème Année Secondaire onwards. Examples include:
• 2ème Informatique, 2ème Sciences, 2ème Lettres
• Bac Informatique, Bac Mathématiques, Bac Sciences Expérimentales

Your filière determines which subjects and courses are available to you on the platform.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Can I see courses from other filières?

By default, Karini shows you courses tailored to your assigned class and filière. If you need access to content from other filières, contact the platform administrator who can adjust your settings. This filtering ensures you focus on your own program's curriculum.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is the student dashboard?

Your student dashboard is the home page you see after logging in. It shows:
• **Your class (filière)** — e.g., Bac Informatique
• **Available credits** — Your current credit balance
• **Membership tier** — Standard, Silver, Gold, or Platinum
• **Learning Categories** — Quick links to Courses, Exercises, Magazines, and Live Archives
• **Quick access buttons** — 'Accéder à mes cours' and 'Gérer mon abonnement & crédits'

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
My class shows as 'Non assignée'. What should I do?

If your class shows as 'Non assignée' (Not assigned), it means the administrator hasn't set your class yet, or there was an issue during registration. Contact the platform administrator or moderator and ask them to assign your class from the admin panel. Once assigned, your courses will automatically be filtered to match your program.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Is there a mobile app?

Karini is currently a web-based platform built with Next.js that works great on both desktop and mobile browsers. You can access it from any device with a modern web browser — just visit the Karini website and log in. The responsive design adapts to your screen size automatically.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Can I use Karini on my phone?

Yes! Karini's website is fully responsive and works on mobile phones and tablets. Simply open your mobile browser (Chrome, Safari, etc.), navigate to the Karini website, and log in. You'll have access to all features including video courses, exercises, messaging, and the live calendar.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I prepare for the Bac on Karini?

Karini is designed with Bac preparation in mind! Here's how to make the most of it:
1. **Watch video courses** systematically through the multi-chapter modules for each subject
2. **Practice with exercises** and review the detailed corrections (corrigés)
3. **Download magazines** with curated exam prep materials
4. **Watch Live Archives** (Gold) to see past exam problem resolutions
5. **Join Live Sessions** (Platinum) for interactive revision with top teachers, open mic Q&A, and step-by-step Bac subject resolution

The Platinum plan is specifically designed to run until June 15 — the Bac exam period.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is the video studio view?

The Video Studio is an interactive viewing mode for video courses. Instead of a simple grid of cards, it displays a playlist on the left with all your video courses (Vid 1, Vid 2, Vid 3…) and a full video player on the right. Click any course in the playlist to start watching. You can switch between Studio view and Grid view using the toggle buttons above the course list.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
Do I get a certificate?

Official validation certificates are available to **Platinum** members. As part of the annual Platinum subscription, you can earn official certificates of achievement as you complete courses and pass assessments.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
How do I check my quiz results?

After submitting a quiz, you'll immediately see your results including:
• Your score and maximum possible score
• Your percentage
• A detailed breakdown of each question showing your answer, the correct answer, and whether you got it right

Your best percentage across all attempts is also tracked and visible in your profile.

You are Karini, a friendly AI assistant for the Karini e-learning platform — a Tunisian digital education platform for students from 7ème Année de Base through Baccalauréat. Answer in a helpful, concise way.
What is the difference between Gold and Platinum?

Here's a clear comparison:

**Gold (Monthly):**
• Everything in Silver (video courses, exercises, magazines)
• ⭐ Exclusive: Live Archives (replays of past live sessions)
• Exclusive Karini content
• Unlimited downloads
• Renews every 30 days with credits

**Platinum (Annual until June 15):**
• 💎 Exclusive: Real-time Live Sessions with teachers (open mic, chat)
